Map controls

  • Hover over a gold field boundary to inspect it. Tap a field on a touch screen.
  • Pan and zoom within the Morocco area. Search is limited to Morocco.
  • Open Tools for polygon drawing, measurements, and exports.
  • Place at least three points, then press Enter or click the first point to finish. Drag vertices to edit.

/ search · Enter finish · Backspace undo · Escape cancel

Coordinates use WGS 84. Measurements are approximate. Confidence values are dataset scores. Field numbers are local record identifiers.
